info.title: Rafiqi API
info.description:
## Rafiqi API

Backend for **Rafiqi** — an AI-powered education platform for teachers and students,
built for the Saudi Arabian (KSA) market.

### Authentication

All protected endpoints require a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
```

Obtain a token pair by calling **POST /auth/login**. Access tokens are short-lived —
exchange the accompanying `refresh_token` for a new pair via **POST /auth/refresh**
rather than logging in again. Call **POST /auth/logout** to revoke a refresh token.

### Multi-tenancy

Every response is automatically scoped to the requesting user's school.
A user from School A will never see data from School B — this is enforced
server-side and cannot be bypassed by the client.

### Roles

| Role | Description |
|---|---|
| `teacher` | Can view class rosters, generate lesson plans, run live sessions |
| `student` | Can chat with Rafiqi, view their own profile, join live sessions |

Routes are role-protected — sending a teacher token to a student-only route
returns `403 Forbidden`.

### Error shape

All errors follow a consistent shape:

```json
{
  "detail": {
    "error": {
      "code": "unauthorized",
      "message": "Invalid or expired token"
    }
  }
}
```

Known error codes: `unauthorized`, `forbidden`, `not_found`, `validation_error`, `internal_error`.

post.description:
Authenticate with email and password. Returns a signed access token plus a
refresh token.

The access token payload contains:
- **sub** — user ID
- **school_id** — the user's school (all data is scoped to this)
- **role** — `teacher` or `student`
- **exp** — expiry (`ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES` from issue)

Pass the access token in every subsequent request:
```
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
```

When it expires, use `POST /auth/refresh` with the `refresh_token` to get a
new pair without asking the user to log in again.

200.description: Successful login — returns a signed access token and a refresh token.

post.description:
Exchange a refresh token for a new access/refresh token pair.

Refresh tokens rotate on every use: the one you send is revoked and a new
one is returned in its place. Reusing an already-exchanged (or logged-out)
refresh token fails with 401.

401.description: Refresh token is invalid, expired, already used, or the account is inactive.

post.description:
Revoke a refresh token so it can no longer be exchanged for a new access token.

This does not invalidate an already-issued access token — it stays valid
until it naturally expires (up to `ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES`), which is
why access tokens are kept short-lived. Always returns 204, whether or not
the token was found, so the response never reveals whether it existed.

204.description: Refresh token revoked. Same response whether or not it was found.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's own record. Available to both roles.

patch.description: Update own `full_name` and/or `password`. Available to both roles.

put.description:
Upload a profile photo. Accepts JPEG, PNG or WebP, maximum 5 MB.
Returns the updated user with `avatar_url` set to `/media/avatars/{id}.{ext}`.
The frontend prefixes this path with the API base URL to build the full image URL.

Available to both roles (own avatar only).

400.description: Unsupported file type (JPEG, PNG, WebP only).

delete.description: Remove own profile photo. Sets `avatar_url` to null. Available to both roles.

get.description:
Returns all users in the teacher's school, ordered by name.

- No `role` filter → returns teachers **and** students.
- `?role=student` → students only.
- `?role=teacher` → teachers only.

Teacher access only.

post.description:
Create a new student or teacher in the same school as the requesting teacher.

Teacher access only.

get.description:
Fetch any user by ID — scoped to the teacher's school.
Returns 404 if the user doesn't exist **or** belongs to a different school.

Teacher access only.

404.description: User not found in this school.

patch.description:
Update another user's `full_name` or `is_active` status.
To update your own record, use `PATCH /users/me`.

Teacher access only.

404.description: User not found in this school.

delete.description:
Soft-deactivate a user (sets `is_active=false`). Deactivated users cannot log in.
Returns the updated user record.

A teacher cannot deactivate their own account.
Teacher access only.

404.description: User not found in this school.

put.description: Upload a profile photo for any user in the school. Teacher access only.

404.description: User not found in this school.

delete.description: Remove a profile photo for any user in the school. Teacher access only.

404.description: User not found in this school.

QuestionOut.title: QuestionOut
QuestionOut.description: Safe projection of a question — answer keys, keywords and hints are excluded.

access_token.title: Access Token
access_token.description: Signed JWT. Include in every protected request as: `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Opaque token used to obtain a new access token via `POST /auth/refresh`. Store it securely — it is not a JWT and cannot be decoded.

UserSelfUpdate.title: UserSelfUpdate
UserSelfUpdate.description: Any user updating their own record — name or password.

UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate
UserUpdate.description: Teacher updating another user — name or active status only.

tags.name: users
tags.description: User management — CRUD for teachers and students within a school. `GET /users/me` and `PATCH /users/me` are available to both roles. All other routes are teacher-only.

tags.name: profiles
tags.description: Student profile — traits, confidence scores, teaching tips. Built automatically from Cave chat (A2/A3). Teachers read; students see their own.

tags.name: conversations
tags.description: Cave chat sessions between a student and Rafiqi (A2). Each session produces profile trait updates (A3).

tags.name: sessions
tags.description: Live class sessions — start, join, real-time sync (C1/C2).
